This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. The [[humanoid]] [[species]] was distinguished by their distinctive [[Helmet|masks]] which possessed an almost beak-like shape, as well as a curved protrusion extending upwards from their cranial area.<ref name="TROS" /> In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi Date">{{KenobiDate|II}}</ref> a member of species attempted to apprehend a young [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] before being shot in the back by [[Jedi]]-in-hiding [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="OWK">{{Kenobi|Part II}}</ref> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROSDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' to [[35 ABY]].</ref> another member of this species was present on the planet [[Pasaana]] during the [[Festival of the Ancestors]].<ref name="TROS" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[2019]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]]'', directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TROS" /> This species was originally designed by concept artist [[Jake Lunt Davies]],<ref name="JLD Insta TROS">{{Instagram|username=jakeluntdavies|url=p/CKC1EVNDDxD|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2021-01-14|quote=Background character design for The Rise of Skywalker. Started off as a guy, reworked as female. She was cool as hell. #starwars #TheRiseofSkywalker #conceptart #conceptdesign #characterdesign #costumedesign #mask #bountyhunter #assassin #mercenary #cfx #artofinstagram #artofstarwars #pistol #hood|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/tMdQg}}</ref> and was referred to by the production code "Wizard 54."<ref name="Artbook">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> Davies personally considers the individuals who appear in both ''The Rise of Skywalker'' and ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' to be one in the same,<ref name="JLD Insta OWK">{{Instagram|username=jakeluntdavies|url=p/CeHhk2mKL0h|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2022-05-28|quote=Nice to see her make a fleeting appearance on Obi Wan. #starwars #obiwankenobi #bountyhunter #starwarsconceptart #conceptdesign #creaturedesign #creaturedesigner #costume #leia #princessleia|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/q16zU}}</ref> though it is unclear if the one in the latter survived being shot by Obi-Wan, which takes place earlier on the timeline.<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>
